displayName: Saks Fifth Avenue API - Designer Sale Prices, Stock, Stores
description: Saks Fifth Avenue product data as structured JSON - search saksfifthavenue.com, browse any category, a designer's page or the Sale and New Arrivals lists, 24 grid positions per page with price, regular and sale price, percent off, badge, final-sale, clearance and returnable flags, promotions and colors, filtered by designer, color, size, any price range, on sale, new arrivals or any facet, read one product with every color and size, per-SKU online units, restock date and the average rating, check a variant's stock at the Saks stores near a ZIP with the store's unit count where the site shows it, find stores, pull search suggestions and the full A-Z designer index. 9 endpoints, 2 credits each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
